You can provide elaborate instructions to follow through the precheckout and checkout pages. 2. Insert table diagrams and other images to show visual aids for the registration process. ![Use Case 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Use%20Case%201.png){height="" width=""} * * * ![Use Case 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Use%20Case%202.png){height="" width=""} ## Instructions 1. Add the {{variable.Field_Event_PrecheckoutDetails}} and {{variable.Field_Event_CheckoutDetails}} fields to the {{variable.Object_Event}} page layout. :::(Info) (Important) If you are using custom permission sets, please make sure these fields are granted access where necessary. ::: 2. Fill in the the {{variable.Field_Event_PrecheckoutDetails}} and {{variable.Field_Event_CheckoutDetails}} fields. 3. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![Instructions 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%201.png){height="" width=""} 4. View the new information on the pre-checkout and checkout pages during registration. **Precheckout Page** ![Instructions 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%202.png){height="" width=""} * * * **Checkout Page** ![Instructions 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Instructions%203.png){height="" width=""}
